case_title.quote: RANDHIR @ RANDHIR PAL & ORS. v. STATE OF HARYANA
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment header.

number_of_accused.correct_value: 11 accused at trial (A1-A11); 5 appellants before the Supreme Court
number_of_accused.reason: Five is the number of appellants before the Court; the trial involved eleven accused, which is omitted.

accused_gender.reason: Accused are named male individuals described as 'S/o' (son of).

accused_age.reason: No age is stated for any accused.

accused_religion.reason: Religion is not stated; 'Brahaman' describes caste, not religion.

accused_caste.correct_value: Brahman (Brahaman) for A2, A4, A7; A8 and A11 caste not given
accused_caste.quote: Lakhmi - A 7 S/o Baru, Brahaman by caste
accused_caste.reason: Judgment describes the accused as Brahaman by caste, not Scheduled Caste; 'Harijan' refers to a witness.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation of the accused is stated.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Victim Laxman is referred to with male pronoun 'his' and as brother.

victim_caste.reason: Victim's caste is not stated; 'Laxman Harijan' is a different witness reference.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Not stated (accused are relatives of Prem, the earlier deceased, not of Laxman)
accused_victim_relationship.quote: innocent family members of the accused persons, were also roped in
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment ties accused to Prem's family, not a stated relationship with victim Laxman.

offence_category.reason: Charges include section 302 (murder) on a victim who was shot dead.

statutory_provisions.quote: under sections 148, 302, 342, 452 read with section 149 of the Indian Penal Code
statutory_provisions.reason: Provisions match those cited in the judgment.

weapon.quote: a country made pistol, knives and 'gandasas' (axes)
weapon.reason: Weapons match the complaint's account of the assault by the other accused.

evidence_type.quote: two prosecution witnesses, who claimed to be eye-witnesses
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness evidence is supported; no medical evidence is discussed in the judgment.

confession.reason: No confession is mentioned in the judgment.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating circumstances are noted in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: the trial court found the appellants guilty of the charges
trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted under the listed sections read with section 149.

high_court_outcome.quote: The above appeal was dismissed by the High Court on 18.9.2009.
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissed the appellants' appeal; 'Not applicable' is wrong.

final_outcome.quote: the appellants (Randhir - A2, Vijay Kumar - A4, Lakhmi Ram - A 7, Shiv Narain - A8 and Manoj - A11) of the charges
final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court allowed the appeal and acquitted the appellants.

offence_finally_established.reason: Appellants were acquitted, so no offence was finally established against them.

imprisonment_type.reason: No sentence was imposed on these appellants following acquittal.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Neutral facts without the Supreme Court outcome; accused alleged only to have prevented persons from entering the shop and passersby from moving, not to have assaulted the victim.
neutral_facts.quote: The Supreme Court further acquitted the remaining accused
neutral_facts.reason: Summary wrongly says witnesses claimed the accused assaulted the victim, and it reveals the court outcome.

offence_severity.reason: No minimum or maximum punishment is stated in the judgment.

attempt_completion.quote: attacked and shot dead in a shop
attempt_completion.reason: Offence is described as completed, with the victim shot dead.

physical_harm.quote: Satpal -A1 fired a shot with the pistol ... which hit the chest
physical_harm.reason: Harm matches the complaint's account of shot and blade and axe injuries.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Charges under ss. 148, 302, 342, 452 r/w s.149; none upheld for the five appellants
number_of_offences.quote: acquit the appellants (Randhir - A2, Vijay Kumar - A4, Lakhmi Ram - A 7, Shiv Narain - A8 and Manoj - A11)
number_of_offences.reason: Four provisions were charged; all five appellants were acquitted, so none was upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is discussed.

premeditation_planning.reason: Premeditation or planning is not stated.

motive.correct_value: Prosecution's motive was the earlier murder of Prem s/o Baru on 30.8.2001, in which the victim was allegedly involved
motive.quote: the motive for committing the crime was the murder of Prem s/o Baru on 30.8.2001
motive.reason: The judgment identifies a motive, namely enmity arising from Prem's earlier murder.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Court relied on PW7 and PW8 to show appellants did not assault the victim, but found PW7's testimony on blocking persons appears false.
key_evidence_accepted.quote: Even as per the statements of two eye-witnesses ... the present five appellants were not involved in the assault
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court did not simply accept the witnesses; it rejected PW7's shop-blocking testimony as false and an afterthought.

witness_credibility.correct_value: PW7 and PW8 are brothers of the deceased; PW7's testimony on blocking persons was found false and contradicted by PW8, not on assault involvement.
witness_credibility.quote: The testimony of Raj Mal - PW7, with reference to stopping persons from coming into the shop ... appears to be false.
witness_credibility.reason: Credibility problems concern the blocking testimony; the witnesses' assault accounts actually exonerated the appellants.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Post-offence conduct of the accused is not stated.

custody_duration.reason: Duration of custody is not stated; the appellants were on bail.

bail_history.quote: Since the present appellants are on bail, their bail bonds shall stand discharged.
bail_history.reason: Judgment confirms the appellants were on bail and bonds were discharged.

trial_duration.reason: Offence, trial judgment, High Court and Supreme Court dates match the judgment.

legal_representation.quote: V. Giri, Sr. Adv., Mrs. Kawaljit Kochar ... Anish Kumar Gupta, AAG
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for appellants and State match the judgment.

investigation_status.quote: the complaint, which came to be converted into the First Information Report
investigation_status.reason: FIR was registered from PW7's complaint on the date of occurrence; witnesses were examined.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Persons named as prevented from entering the shop were not recorded during investigation or trial
procedural_irregularity.quote: neither the concerned passersby, nor the persons named ... were recorded during the course of the investigation
procedural_irregularity.reason: The judgment notes investigative lapses about unrecorded named persons, so 'None noted' is incomplete.

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court dismissal and Supreme Court acquittal are all correctly stated.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Prosecution case was that the appellants stood outside the shop preventing persons from entering and passersby from moving; not that they joined the assault.
prosecution_argument.quote: it is not even the case of the prosecution witnesses ... that the present five appellants, were in any way involved in the injuries
prosecution_argument.reason: Judgment says the prosecution did not allege the appellants were involved in the assault or injuries.

defence_argument.correct_value: Appellants were not involved in the assault inside the shop; the case was an effort to rope in family members due to enmity over Prem's murder.
defence_argument.quote: the effort now was to involve as many members of the family as possible
defence_argument.reason: Defence argued non-involvement and enmity; the claim that the witnesses' statements were false is not attributed to the defence.

legal_principle_applied.quote: it is difficult to conclude with certainty ... entitled to the benefit of doubt
legal_principle_applied.reason: Court applied the reasonable doubt standard and benefit of doubt to acquit.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: No precedent is cited in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentencing occurred, so 'Not applicable' is consistent.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: No judicial mitigating factors are identified.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: No judicial aggravating factors are identified.

other_sentence_order.quote: their bail bonds shall stand discharged
other_sentence_order.reason: Only the bail bond discharge is ordered; no other sentence order is made.
